skill.name: when-optimizing-prompts-use-prompt-optimization-analyzer
skill.description: Analyze prompt quality, detect token waste and anti-patterns, and produce practical recommendations for clearer AI instructions.
skill.summary: Diagnoses prompt quality issues and recommends clearer, shorter instructions.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are false positives caused by Markdown fences and JavaScript template literals. The real issue is repeated guidance to run npx claude-flow@alpha hook and memory commands, which can execute mutable third-party package code. No prompt injection attempt was found.

remediation.suggestion: Pin claude-flow to a reviewed immutable version, or replace npx examples with manual steps that require explicit user approval.

remediation.issue: Workflow examples encourage external hook execution
remediation.suggestion: Label hook and memory commands as optional, document expected effects, and provide a no-execution analysis path.

content.value_statement: Prompt libraries often grow verbose, inconsistent, and hard to maintain. This skill diagnoses prompt quality issues and turns them into practical optimization steps.
actual_capabilities: Measures token waste from redundancy, verbosity, and filler words.
Detects vague instructions, undefined terms, conflicts, and missing context.
Reviews trigger conditions for clarity, specificity, and scope.
Produces prioritized recommendations with before and after comparisons.
Estimates token savings and clarity improvements after optimization.
limitations: It does not guarantee exact model token counts.
Heuristic scores need human review before publication decisions.
The npx workflow examples require security review before use.
It does not rewrite files unless an agent applies the changes.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Skill for Publication
use_cases.description: Review a new skill prompt for clarity, token waste, and weak trigger conditions before release.

use_cases.title: Improve a Prompt Library
use_cases.description: Compare prompts across a team and identify repeated wording, vague rules, and maintenance problems.

use_cases.title: Refine Support Instructions
use_cases.description: Turn broad agent guidance into clear steps, measurable outcomes, and easier review criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Find Basic Token Waste
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this prompt for repeated phrases, filler words, and vague instructions. Return the top five fixes and estimated token savings: [paste prompt].

prompt_templates.title: Improve Skill Instructions
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review before publishing a skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill prompt for token efficiency, trigger clarity, and conflicting requirements. Prioritize issues by severity: [paste skill content].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Before and After
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of an edited prompt.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these prompt versions. Explain what improved, what became weaker, and whether the optimized version keeps the original intent: [paste both versions].

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Prompt Library Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these related prompts as a library. Identify shared anti-patterns, overlapping triggers, and a phased optimization plan: [paste prompt set].

output_examples.input: A vague code review prompt with repeated phrases and broad quality goals.
output_examples.output: The analyzer identifies repeated wording, replaces vague adjectives with review criteria, and recommends a shorter structured review process.

output_examples.input: A skill trigger that says to use the skill for anything related to prompts.
output_examples.output: The analyzer flags the trigger as too broad and suggests clear activation conditions, exclusions, and examples.

output_examples.input: Two versions of the same prompt before and after editing.
output_examples.output: The analyzer compares token savings, retained intent, clarity gains, and any important instruction loss.

best_practices: Provide the full prompt, target user, model, and token goal.
Fix high-severity clarity issues before optimizing only for length.
Run the analysis again after major prompt changes.
anti_patterns: Optimizing only for token count when precision is required.
Treating heuristic scores as final quality guarantees.
Running external workflow commands without approval and version pinning.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes prompt wording, structure, triggers, redundancy, and common instruction anti-patterns.

faq.question: Does it edit prompts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It produces recommendations and comparisons. An agent or user must apply the changes.

faq.question: Can it provide exact token counts?
faq.answer: It estimates token savings. Exact counts depend on the tokenizer used by the target model.

faq.question: Is it useful for Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review instructions meant for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the full prompt, intended use, target model, and any token or quality constraints.

faq.question: Are the workflow commands required?
faq.answer: No. Treat external command examples as optional and review them before running anything.
